steps.en: Install the skill into your agent's skills directory with one command
steps.zh: 一行命令把 skill 装进 agent 的 skills 目录

steps.en: Ask for the cards in plain words
steps.code: 帮我做一套小红书图文

steps.en: Runs Intake: locks platform, style, content and images; with none, offers a one-shot own/AI/web pick
steps.zh: Intake：锁定平台/风格/内容/图，无图时一次性给三选

steps.en: Answer: Editorial or Swiss, a preset theme, hand over photos or approve web sourcing
steps.zh: 回答：选 Editorial 或 Swiss 与主题预设，给图或授权取图

steps.en: Picks from the 28 layouts, caches images + writes SOURCES.md, fills the seed template, renders PNGs
steps.zh: 选版式、落图写 SOURCES.md、填模板并渲染 PNG

steps.en: Review the PNGs yourself; run the 9-rule validator or ask the agent to iterate
steps.zh: 先看 PNG，再决定跑校验器还是直接改

value.en: Platform-exact PNG carousels and cover pairs (plus Live Photo bundles) without opening a design tool
value.zh: 平台精确尺寸的 PNG 组图与封面对（外加 Live Photo 发布包），全程不碰设计工具
